lines.en: The following morning...somewhere in the Old District...
If there was anything in life Yuki hated more than the Yamaguchi estate, it was the man who ran it.
That wasn’t always the case, though.
To be clear, she never had any respect for him. But back when taking his name sounded like a good idea, her feelings hadn’t blossomed into hate yet.
That would come over the next several years between the bouts of willing sedation that he’d thrust upon her in exchange for sex.
“A fair trade,” she thought. And it’s not as if she would remember most of it anyway as the showering of presents would be a blanket she could hold over her face to ignore what was happening.
“Just a few more minutes. One more mouthful. Then the world will be mine again. And I can forget why I’m here in the first place.”
It became less bearable as time went on. And the salty aftertaste of poor decisions went from tolerable to cancerous each time she’d wake up in a pool of her own spit.
She was still doing that nowadays, but at least the salt was gone.
The shame never left, though. And it was more prevalent now than it had been in a very long time as she promised herself she’d only come here if and when she ran out of options.
Because she always knew it was only a matter of time. And she knew that, one way or another, her past would catch up to her and force her back underwater.
And while the specifics this time were somewhat different than they’d been in the past, the end result remained the same.
She needed money. And she had access to money.
But it would come at a cost.
: It’s been a while since you last showed up here, Yuki.
: At least since deciding to show yourself in front of me.
: I remember hearing something about you coming to visit the girl, though. When it was her turn to come crying back.
: She has a name...
: Of course she does. You gave her one. Which makes it all the more surprising why you just quit after that.
: Normally, people get at least a little attached to something after naming it.
: I’m not here to talk about Yumi...
: Oh? Why are you here then?
: You need money, don’t you?
: I had a job, but...
: But you fucked it up, didn’t you?
: You do that a lot, huh?
: Yeah...I do that a lot.
: How much?
: As much as you’ll allow me...
: For drugs?
: You look like shit. What is it this time? Heroin again?
: It doesn’t matter...
: It does matter when you come here asking for my money. So if I ask you a question, you will answer it. Then I can make an informed decision. Understood?
: Yes, Yoshitsugu...
: Did I give you permission to address me so casually? It’s Danna-sama. We used to kill women for disrespecting their husband, you know.
: Yes...Danna-sama.
: Good girl. Obedient. You must be desperate.
: ...Yes. Danna-sama.
: Heh...you must be very desperate. You won’t even look at me.
: Where’s that fire, Yuki? You used to be a terror. Half of these men have never even met you and they’re still afraid because of the stories.
: You’re going to make me look like a liar if you keep this up.
: I apologize...Danna-sama. I’m very tired these days. I don’t have it in me to fight anymore.
: You know, that’s kind of funny. Because I recall hearing something just a short while ago about you breaking one of my captain’s bones just for talking to a girl. Is this true, Yuki?
: Mnh...
: Is it true? Or is he the liar here?
: With all due respect, Danna-sama...
: If that man was a captain, I can only imagine how weak the rest of your men are.
: Ha! There’s the Yuki I know. There’s the Dragon.
: Rest assured — I still took his pinkie. You are still my wife, after all.
: And even if you’re still out there fucking everything up the way you always do, I can’t have you making me look bad. Just maybe mind your own fucking business from now on.
: After all, what’s the point in running away if you’re just going to keep getting involved?
: I apologize for causing you trouble...I am only here to beg for your assistance as I am afraid that I will die without it.
: Right...And what happens when you run out again? When can I expect you back? Would you like to schedule your next meeting now?
: This is the last time...I swear.
: Mm...I wonder how many “last times” it’s been now.
: Please...Danna-sama.
: Why not just move back in? I have plenty of new recruits to make up for the ones who were shipped off. They could use someone to train them.
: And you know how well you’re taken care of here. That’s what made me so appealing in the first place, isn’t it?
: I...can’t do that. I apologize, Danna-sama.
: Hmm...unfortunate. Don’t even want to give it a shot? I’ll even let you choose who to kick the shit out of first.
: It was always fun watching you lose yourself. I’d hate for that to just be a memory.
: I will do anything you ask...but I can not stay here. I do not wish to burden you any more than I already have.
: Just the money then?
: Please, Danna-sama...anything you can spare. I have no one else to turn to...
: Yeah, probably because you’ve fucked every other relationship you’ve ever had up. But alright. Fine. Let’s see it. On your knees.
: Yes...Danna-sama.
Chatter erupts throughout the room as the dragon is brought to its knees. And as she prostrates herself before the man who downed her, a fit of violent laughter erupts from out of his throat.
The rest gaze on in a mix of shock and awe. Those who know her can not believe their eyes, while those who don’t glance skeptically at one another, unsure of what to make of this.
Was this really the woman they were taught to fear? This frail, decaying sack of flesh with so little pride left that she would dogeza without quarrel in front of each and every one of them?
She holds herself there with her head against the floor, breathing in the scent of the tatami and wishing desperately that this is where it ends.
But of course that would be too easy. And of course she’d have to swallow the rest of her pride along with the true cost of what she needed from this man.
: Oh, Yuki. You know that’s not what I meant.
: Please, Danna-sama...
: I can’t.
: What do you mean you can’t? You’re my wife. It’s your duty to please me. And in this state, it’s the only use you have now.
: I beg you...anything else.
: Yuki...I think you’re misunderstanding something.
: Ngh?!
: I am not asking you. I am commanding you.
: When I say “bark,” you bark. When I say “jump,” you jump. And when I say to get down on your fucking knees and open your fucking mouth, what do you do?
: Please...don’t...
: What...do...you...fucking...do?
Exactly as he says...
Because that’s what needs to be done if she wants to survive.
And just like in the old days, a mouthful of salt would soon be worth the payoff.
She’d just first need to get her hands on something to help her forget as she was coasting on fumes right now.
So she felt every vein — every pubic hair that crept into her mouth despite desperate attempts to dodge them while he proceeded to degrade her in front of a crowd of his underlings.
And for him, this was perfect. The power he felt slaying a dragon bled out like fanfare and echoed throughout the room, rallying his troops behind him as they shouted their praise.
For her, it was much worse.
: Mlgh...mlgkhhhk!.......Mrglrlh.......glmpckhkc?!....
: Ah, yes...just like I remember...
: Crowd and all...
: Mmmlggh....mmngh....grllrplppl!
: You like that, don’t you?...You’ve always fucking liked it, Yuki...
: You talk...big, and...you...ngh...act tough...but deep down...you love it when you’re...fucking used like this...
: Mlmgll!! MMmghh! Mlmrlrlpp!
: Yeah...that’s right...just a little longer...
: Juuuust like you used to do it...then you can shoot up as much as you want...
: Mllgh....mlgghgh!!!
: Yeah, I bet you’re excited...You’d do anything for money, wouldn’t you? And you’d like it too, you little slut...
: Mmmngh....mlmgpgp....mmlglpppp!!!
She wanted to puke. She hated his taste. His smell. The sound of his voice. How he’d force her down without regard for whether or not she could breathe.
But she had to endure. Just a little while longer.
Just a little while longer.
Just a little while-
: Mngh...fuck...get ready to swallow, Yuki...Get ready to...fucking swallow, you...junkie bitch!
: Mmmlgh! Mmllghlg! Mmmnhgh! Mmllgchklprllpr!!
As he filled her mouth with liquid disdain, she remembered a mantra she used to think to herself during times like this.
It went something like — “Don’t bite down. Don’t bite down. Don’t bite down.”
And it was that exact mantra that carried her through to the end of his violent, hateful ejaculation.
He shoves her backward by her shoulders once he’s finished, but she manages to stay upright, quickly wiping away the mix of juices left clinging to her mouth.
: Ahh...what a nice trip down memory lane that was. Thanks for coming all the way here just to catch up, Yuki. Same time next week?
: Phfht....pfhht...blech...we done here?...
: Are we done here what?
: Are we done here...Danna-sama?
: Are we? You still haven’t told me how much you need.
: I already said...whatever you can spare.
: See, that’s just the thing. I have plenty to spare. And for as little as ¥20,000, I could have a girl half your age and five times as attractive shipped right to my door.
: That said, how about ¥10,000? That should get you high a few times, right?
: You know I need more than that...
: Oh? What happened to “anything you can spare?”
: Yoshitsugu...
: Danna-sama.
: Forgive me, Danna-sama...but I must ask you kindly...to consider a larger amount...
: This is for more than just getting high...
: Hey now, ¥10,000 could go a long way if you just quit doing drugs again. You’ve done that...what, fifty times before, haven’t you? Should be good at it by now.
: What else do you want?...
: Come back to the family. Train my men.
: Bite me.
: Fine, fine. Since that’s so out of the question, how about this then? Stand up. Strip.
: So what? You just want to degrade me now? Because we both know you ain’t gettin’ hard again for at least an hour, you limp-dicked piece of shit.
: You fucking-
: Sorry. You limp-dicked piece of shit, Danna-sama.
Chatter again. Louder this time as the dragon attempts to roar.
But it’s brought down once more when she comes to her senses.
This would all be for nothing if she leaves empty-handed. And if she had to stand around and wait for an hour just to get what she came here for, so be it.
She’d do whatever she had to.
But the way these men encircled her made her fear as if that would be more than she ever expected.
: The fuck are you lookin’ at? Back off.
: I imagine he’s looking at you, Yuki. Which I’d probably be flattered by at your age.
: Tell me — have you found someone else yet? Or are you still running around pretending wolves can survive without a pack?
: The fuck do you think, Danna-sama? Think I’d really come here if I had someone else I could suck off for money?
: There are plenty of people you can suck off for money. You’re probably just not looking hard enough.
: Yeah, guess not. Can we do this now? I ain’t got all fuckin’ day. I’ll just shove my fist up your ass or something. That’ll probably get you hard, right?
: I knew your pleasant attitude was too good to be true. You’ll never change. That’s why you’re still fucking up and still desperate for me to come rescue you to this day.
: I can’t do that forever, Yuki. Not for you. For my daughter maybe, but some whore I picked up off the street? Yeah, I don’t think so.
: You married me, dipshit. I ain’t a fuckin' street whore.
: Right, yeah. You’re my street whore.
: And seeing as you’re my street whore, I am free to do as I please with you. Is that correct?
: Sure. Fine. You don’t give a shit about my blessing anyway if you’re just gonna tell me these are all commands.
: I sucked your filthy dick. I stripped in front of your fucking evil henchmen. Now, I assume you’re gonna fuck me. What’s after that, Danna-sama? Want to hold hands?
: How much would that cost? Sounds quite uncharacteristic for a street whore.
: First ten minutes’ll run ya ¥100,000. Every ten after that, price gets shaved down to ¥50,000.
: You in? Might be the first time you’ve ever been touched without havin’ to force it.
: Aww, you’re saying you’d do it willingly? Maybe you have changed.
: Are you gonna fuck me or not? I’m gettin’ bored.
: Hmm...sorry. No can do, Yuki. Like you said, I’m still not hard yet.
: There are plenty of other men here I’m sure you could satisfy, though. And hey? Maybe watching them degrade you might turn me on? I’ve always liked that.
: You fucking wouldn’t...
: I wasn’t going to if you stayed obedient. But now you’ve made me mad. And I honestly just don’t really give a shit about you at this point, so yeah. Have at her, boys.
: No- don’t you fucking touch me! You have any idea who you’re laying your hands on?!
: Oh, give it a break. How about ¥50,000 for each one you get off? Saves me a trip to the soapland next week.
: I’m your fucking wife! What’s this say about you, you fucking cuck?! You think these guys will still respect you after they watch you jerking off to this?!
: I think it says that I’m very grateful for their loyalty and that I don’t mind sharing. Which you too will soon reap the benefits of at ¥50,000 a head. Have fun, Yuki!
: No! Fuck that! And who the fuck are you?! Do you have any idea how fucked you are once I’m-
: MMNGNGHH?!?!!?!
: This really the same person you’ve been talkin’ about, Boss? Thought you said she was stronger than all of us put together.
: She used to be...probably getting older now. Or just high. I’m staying out either way. I don’t want to be on her bad side next time she comes back.
: LMMMGO!!!! ILLFCKNGKLLYYOU!!!! YFCKINGMNGHHGH!
: Oh, okay. I can feel it now. Yeah, I can see how she was strong once.
: MMNNGHGHGHHHH!
: Can we really, like...you know...do her, Boss?
: MMMNMNNHHHHH!!!
: Hmm...
: You know...she is the mother of my child. And I do still have hope for Yumi...so I would like to stay on her good side.
: MMM! MMMMMHHH!!
: But at the same time, she really needs the money and I wouldn’t want to hold her back from such a great opportunity.
: MMMMMMMM!!!!!!
: So again! Have fun, Yuki!
: God damn...she ain’t even a little wet. Feels like I’m fucking a tube-sock.
: MNLGLGHGLLGL! MMNGHGHGHH!!
: Don’t worry, dude. I’ll fix that. My ex told me I have “magic fingers.” The trick is to stimulate her clit with brief and delicate motions and you can start by making little circles around-
: You fucker! You totally just touched my dick!
: MMMNGHH! MMMNGHHGHHG! MMNFHHGHGHGH?!?!?!!
: Oh, sorry. My bad.
: You good over on the front end, man? You sure you want to, like...be in her mouth? You ain’t afraid she’s gonna bite you or something?
: Hah...hah...it’ll be...worth it if she does! I’ve been...wanting to do this...for years now!
: Oh yeah, you grew up around here didn’t you? Wasn’t your dad a captain? He get sent off to space with the rest of the other old guys?
: Hah...yeah! He...sure did! I’ve been...hanging out here since...I was a kid!
: Oh damn, you must’ve seen her in her prime then. Was she hot?
: She...still is! God...I’m gonna fucking cum! Oh fuck, it’s a dream come true!
: MNNGHGHGHGHGHHG!! MMMPPLSLSSSSLSSS!!!!!
: Oh, no...oh, fuck! She looks so sad! Oh fuck! Aaah! I can’t help it! I’m sorry, Yuki! I’m...so sorry!
Just a little while longer.
Just a little while longer...
: Jesus...fuck! I can’t tell if she’s...wet or...if that’s just...cum from the last guy...
: Yeah...sorry...probably me! Been...ngh...holding it in for...weeks now! Couldn’t...help myself!
She’d stopped fighting back.
Her hand moved mechanically as it wrapped around the curved cock of yet another man she couldn’t see the face of.
But on the bright side, she couldn’t taste much of anything anymore now that her sinuses had swollen shut from hours of crying.
The man who ran the estate still loomed in the back of the room — his eyes fixated on the broadcast of a soccer game while his men proceeded to violate his wife.
The volume was loud enough for Yuki to keep track of the score, so she kept herself distracted by doing that for a while until the lack of air made it nearly impossible to focus.
Just a little while longer.
Just a little while longer.
Just think of the money.
Just think of the high.
Just think of something.
Anything.
This isn’t where you’re meant to die.
: Uhh...boss?
: Hm? What?
: Oh — Yuki. Right. She still breathing?
: Shaking a lot, but yeah. She’s still breathing.
: Good. Because I’d be taking all of your pinkies if you fuckers killed my wife. Yuki! Time to wake up!
: I’m, uhh...not sure she can walk right now, Boss. Or...speak. A few of the guys really did a number on her.
: You’re the one who wanted to fuck her ass. She was totally fine before that.
: I’d never gotten to try before. I wanted to see what it was like.
: If she can’t walk, just fucking...toss her out onto the street or something. I don’t know.
: What about her clothes?
: Yeah, and doesn’t she need to get paid still? I think there were twenty of us so that’s...what? A million, right?
: Yuki! How many dicks did you take tonight? Got a number?
: None? Sounds good to me. Throw her outside. She smells like shit now and we literally just got the tatami cleaned.
: But Boss-
: I told you to fucking throw her out! When I say “bark,” you bark. When I say, “jump-“
: Yeah, yeah. We all jump. Come on, I’ll help you carry her. I just want to find, like...gloves first.
Somewhere in the midst of everything, it started to rain.
How long had it been since then?
Yuki Yamaguchi was tossed outside of the estate grounds, left there like a bag of trash to be collected the next time the truck came around.
It was cold, but it was a welcome cold. Worsened only by the fact that the water pouring down from the sky did little to wash away the sins of man.
It was like this when she’d shower too, though.
Because from Yuki’s point of view, she was permanently unclean. And it’s not as if any of this mattered now that her life was coming to an end.
She wasn’t even thinking about the money anymore.
She was just glad to be alive — if even for a minute longer.
But then there was a sound.
Footsteps, coming closer.
Footsteps that weren’t dying out.
A last burst of energy grants her the strength to lift her head and witness the truck pull up to carry her away.
: Aaah...
But when she lifts her head, what she sees is not a truck. Nor the headlights that signal the end of her days.
: Well, well, well...
And yet...
She will still be collected.
: If it isn’t the Dragon herself.
: Tough day, I take it?
: Nee...sama?...
: Long time, no see...
: Yuki.
I haven’t seen Niki or Ami since we made it back from the beach...
But everyone else will still accept me...
Won’t they?
I should...figure out what to do next.
